qs.q: Why is cleaning the open ocean so difficult?
o: Fish and seabirds refuse to leave the polluted water.
Engineers cannot build barriers that float on the sea.
The waste is made of small pieces spread over wide areas.
Rivers carry far more waste than the whole ocean can hold.
